newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: TENNIS-CHANG SWEEPS INTO THIRD ROUND.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-CHANG SWEEPS INTO THIRD ROUND.

text.p: World number two Michael Chang powered into the third round of the Australian Open with a relentless 6-3 7-5 6-1 demolition of fellow American Richey Reneberg on Wednesday.
Chang, the second seed, has not won a grand slam since his victory at the French Open in 1989 at the age of 17.
But the defeat of defending champion Boris Becker has given him a clearer run through the draw in Melbourne, setting up a possible final against U.S. world number one Pete Sampras.
On Wednesday, 24-year-old Chang was playing at the top of his game, pushing the hard-working Reneberg around the court at will and dominating the rallies from the baseline.
